mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO inquiry ( title, content, is_secret,
product_id,
upper_inquiry_id,
created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{isSecret},
#{productId},
#{upperInquiryId},
#{createdAt}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.title, i.content, i.is_secret, i.is_answered, i.created_at, i.created_by, u.username, u.phone, p.product_name, a.title AS answer_title, a.content AS answer_content, a.created_at AS answer_created_at FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = i.created_by LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN inquiry a ON a.upper_inquiry_id = i.inquiry_id WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( product_id, content, review_images, rating, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{content}, #{reviewImages}, #{rating}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT review_count as totalCount, avg_rating as averageRating FROM product_review_stats WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review_stats (product_id, avg_rating, review_count) VALUES (#{productId}, #{rating}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE avg_rating = ROUND((avg_rating * review_count + #{rating}) / (review_count + 1), 1), review_count = review_count + 1
